newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures slip on firm yen, weak Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures slip on firm yen, weak Chicago.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended lower on Tuesday, depressed by the lower Chicago market overnight and the strong yen against the dollar, traders said.
The benchmark March 1998 contract ended 390 yen lower at 16,270 yen per tonne. Other prices ranged from 30 yen to 370 yen lower. Volume was estimated at 67,578 lots.
On the CBOT Project A overnight trading system, most-active March corn futures traded at $2.88-1/4 per bushel as of 0840 GMT, down 0-3/4 from Monday's close.
CBOT Project A March soybeans stood at $7.75 per bushel, compared with $7.75 on Monday.
